Variants.Content: Stone Dance City is located on the Royal Coast and is one of the traditional seats of the Marseille family. Its significance was to connect small inland territories with the shores of Blackwater Bay: the road brought grain and levies, and the bay brought merchant ships, catches, messages, and dangers. Crown castles often don't have the ease of distant borders; they're too close to the King's Landing, where the aftermath of any royal marriage, tax, edict, or coup may arrive first. Stonedance does not exist solely on its walls; its lords and residents alike depend on the port, neighboring estates, and the sea seasons.
Entry Stonedance Local families also rely on fishing, salt production, docks, volcanic rock fields and narrow sea navigation; if any road, well or dock fails, the price falls first on them.

Entry Stonedance They'll also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of Dragonstone's waters; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hooves.

Entry Stonedance If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

The traces left by generations of people in Stone Dance City are half hidden in the ship repair wood, canvas, salt, fish catch, and stones used to resist the sea wind. The other half are hidden in the memories of the temple, flames, and old dragons left when the faith of the Seven Gods and the Lord of Light coexisted. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Stonedance They care about fishing, salt industry, wharves, volcanic rock fields and narrow sea shipping. They also care about whether seeds are left after harvesting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
